_comment: Spanish wave 2 (#6559): works not on IA in wave 1, plus Quirós once its Google-scan volumes were told apart by the djvu text.

BNE Biblioteca Digital Hispánica blocks this network outright (Cloudflare block page, 2026-10-11); not attempted further. Martín Cortés 1551 is on IA but the scan is CC BY-NC-ND (Larramendi), left for a rights call.

books.title: Historia del descubrimiento de las regiones austriales hecho por el general Pedro Fernández de Quirós, tomo I
books.author: Pedro Fernández de Quirós (ed. Justo Zaragoza)
books.note: Madrid 1876 (Justo Zaragoza ed., Biblioteca Hispano-Ultramarina), first printing of Quirós's account of the 1595 and 1605-06 South Sea voyages (Marquesas, Tuamotus, Vanuatu, the search for Terra Australis). Google scan; tome identified from the djvu text.
